text: Hammerlocke—always such a dusty town.\c\nThough I suppose some Pokémon prefer it\nthat way.[VAR 0114(0013)]
Didn’t we just part ways?\nI certainly seem to run into you a lot.[VAR 0114(0013)]
Hm? That boy...[VAR 0114(0013)]
Now that’s what I would call pink![VAR 0114(0013)]

Come to gawk at me now that I’ve had my
Challenge Band taken away and my Gym
Challenger status revoked?\c
Can you really afford to waste time like this?[VAR 0114(000C)]
Of course!
Not really...
Well, I suppose so.\nYou no longer have to worry about catching up\r\nwith me, after all.[VAR 0114(000C)]
I commend your humility. It is appropriate for a\nTrainer of your...limited talents.[VAR 0114(000C)]

I’ll have you know, though, that I haven’t given up!\c
I must become the Champion in order to help
out the chairman! I will go and ask him to let me
rejoin the Gym Challenge![VAR 0114(000C)]

So sincere and straightforward and yet so
twisted and misguided...\c
I like it! That’s the kind of thing that gives people
some depth![VAR 0114(0013)]

Now, listen. I’ll let you attempt my Gym mission,
even if you’re not a Gym Challenger.\c
In fact, I don’t plan on giving you a choice, so
don’t even think about refusing.[VAR 0114(0013)]
Time for my Gym mission, child![VAR 0114(0013)]
Huh? Wha—?![VAR 0114(000C)]
And pink![VAR 0114(0013)]
Congratulations, child![VAR 0114(0013)]
You are most definitely pink.[VAR 0114(0013)]
M-Ms. Opal?\nWhat in the world has gotten into you?![VAR 0114(000C)]

You were used by Oleana—am I right?
You worked hard to gather Wishing Stars for her,
only to have her throw you away like rubbish
once she was done with you...[VAR 0114(0013)]

Come with me, child.
I might be able to help you out.\c
Of course, it all depends on how much hard work
you’re willing to put in, too.[VAR 0114(0013)]

Are you... Are you testing me?\c
Very well, I accept! In fact, I plan on making
sure you see my full talents and tell me
everything you know about the Wishing Stars![VAR 0114(000C)]
Farewell for now, child.\nYou should head to Circhester.\r\nI take it you know how to get to Route 7.[VAR 0114(0013)]
